architecture.runtime: AcceleratedResidualObserver with streamed four-polynomial Hermite transport

decision.promote_longer_fixed_training_if: primary gate fails but protected raw MSE <= 5e-7 or training diagnostics establish a still-steep improving trajectory
decision.scope_of_negative: A failure closes this exact four-epoch discriminator only. It does not close the previously untrained H128/P4/C256 architecture unless optimization and fit diagnostics separately establish a capacity ceiling.

evaluation.primary_metric: protected aggregate final-layer raw MSE at the fixed epoch-4 state

graph_binding.question: Can the materially different, already-metered recurrent-Hermite observer cross raw MSE 1e-7 at sub-10-percent Phase-2 compute?

preprocessing.normalization: train-fold-only deterministic rank-order parallel-Welford merges over x02:x20; population standard deviation floored at 2^-20
preprocessing.residual_scales: train-fold-only per-layer RMS(host-target), population denominator, floored at 2^-20
preprocessing.standardization: frozen observer standardize_raw_features law; clamp [-8,8] and exact depth coordinate

training.batching: filter frozen V3 688-position epoch permutation to train ranks; the final odd row uses the same single-network loss
training.loss: frozen exact_training_loss: final normalized MSE + 0.25 all-layer normalized MSE + 1e-4 correction energy + 1e-4 hidden energy
training.optimizer: frozen V3 AdamW(lr=1e-3, betas=[0.9,0.999], eps=1e-8, weight_decay=1e-5)
training.training_progress_metrics: training loss and gradient norm only; no protected target metric before the fixed terminal state
